properties.displayName: UAV S52 - Container Resource Exhaustion DoS (SYN Flood)
properties.description: UAVContainerOps_CL에서 컨테이너 CPU 고갈(>90%)과 연결 폭증(>200)이 5분 이상 2개 이상 구간에서 동시 지속되는 SYN flood형 리소스 고갈 DoS 탐지. MITRE: T0816,T1499
properties.query:
let alertWindow = 20m;
let cpuGate = 90.0;
let connGate = 200;
UAVContainerOps_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
| summarize MaxCpu = max(CpuUsagePct), MaxConn = max(ConnCount) by ContainerName, UAVId, TimeBin = bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where MaxCpu > cpuGate and MaxConn > connGate
| summarize SustainedBins = count(), FirstBin = min(TimeBin), LastBin = max(TimeBin), PeakCpu = max(MaxCpu), PeakConn = max(MaxConn) by ContainerName, UAVId
| extend DurationMin = datetime_diff("minute", LastBin, FirstBin)
| where SustainedBins >= 2 and DurationMin >= 5
| extend TriggerReason = strcat(ContainerName, "_SYNflood_CPU고갈_", tostring(toint(PeakCpu)), "%_Conn", tostring(PeakConn))
| extend Severity = "High"
| project LastBin, FirstBin, ContainerName, UAVId, PeakCpu, PeakConn, SustainedBins, DurationMin, TriggerReason, Severity
| order by LastBin desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: UAV S52 - Container Resource Exhaustion DoS (SYN Flood) - {{ContainerName}}
